what: Stacked photos swap in turn through a fog-cloud mask — after a 3s hold, the soft fog mask of the front photo (3×4.5 times the panel) travels from top right (100% 0%) to 50% 70% over 3s, so the front photo vanishes like fog lifting, while the next photo underneath settles from 1.05 times to 1 over 2s. After 2s the 3s count starts again (one cycle is 5s). Curve cubic-bezier(.3,.015,.12,1). Pauses when off screen

options.settle: Seconds for the next Section to settle — counts again after this, default 2

from.where: index.html .ky-hero__slider (four hero photos — original counter: intervalTime 3000 · setTime 2000, .isPrev mask-position 100% 0% → 50% 70% 3s, .isActive img scale 1.05 → 1 2s)

note: The original fog mask image (mask.webp) was not carried over, it was redrawn as an SVG with the same structure (opaque blob at top right, soft edge)
